name: Bananet
author: banan
description: Bananet — where does your traffic go? Networks, tunnels, egress route and per-service connections in the Omarchy bar: Wi-Fi, Ethernet, Tailscale, ZeroTier, WireGuard / MikroTik Back To Home, OpenVPN, public IP and its owner, live throughput with 24 h charts, routes, DNS, which services talk to which addresses over which link, and alerts when the egress link, the public IP or the listening services change.

barWidget.description: Networks, tunnels, egress and per-service connections with 24 h charts, DNS-leak warning, egress / public IP / new-listener alerts, captive-portal and open-Wi-Fi warnings and a ping-through-link check. Click for the panel.

schema.label: Refresh interval while panel is open (seconds)
Show egress label next to the icon (e.g. "wifi +2")
Bar icon: banana, emoji, or globe
Check the public IP and its owner (icanhazip.com + ipinfo.io, every 5 min or when the route changes)
Notify when the internet starts leaving through a different link (a tunnel drops), a captive portal appears or an open Wi-Fi carries traffic untunnelled
Notify when the public IP changes without the egress link changing (ISP re-lease, VPN server switch)
Notify when a new service starts listening on a non-loopback address (TCP, or UDP on well-known ports)
Offer a one-click ping through each link (three echo requests to the tunnel's far end or the gateway)
Allow switching the Tailscale exit node from the panel (two clicks, runs `tailscale set`)
Resolve remote host names (reverse DNS, cached)
Try passwordless sudo for wg / zerotier-cli / ss
Include loopback connections in service lists
Demo mode (synthetic data, for screenshots or trying it out)
